    • Client

      protected Client()
      Protected no-argument constructor for JPA.

    • Client

      public Client(UUID clientId, String email, String phone, String status, OffsetDateTime createdAt, String fullName, LocalDate dateOfBirth, String ssn, String addressLine1, String addressLine2, String city, String stateRegion, String postalCode, String countryCode, String experienceLevel, BigDecimal initialDepositAmount)
      Method to create a new Client entity with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      clientId - the unique identifier of the client
      email - the email address of the client
      phone - the phone number of the client
      status - the status of the client (e.g., active, inactive)
      createdAt - the timestamp when the client was created
      fullName - the full name of the client
      dateOfBirth - the date of birth of the client
      ssn - the social security number of the client
      addressLine1 - the first line of the client's address
      addressLine2 - the second line of the client's address (optional)
      city - the city of the client's address
      stateRegion - the state or region of the client's address
      postalCode - the postal code of the client's address
      countryCode - the country code of the client's address
      experienceLevel - the experience level of the client
      initialDepositAmount - the initial deposit amount of the client
